result_schema.selection_score: Normalized scalar in [0, 1]; higher is better.
result_schema.cases: List of per-case results; each case carries its own metrics, feedback, and artifacts.
result_schema.case_id: Stable identifier for one evaluated case.

analysis_instruction: Inspect result.json and its cases and artifacts. Infer recurring failure patterns across cases; do not optimize for one case_id or one stochastic trace.
artifact_resolution: During MetaAgent execution, artifact paths in result.json are relative to /tmp/evaluation_history.
